driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%. Scope limit of this measurement: judges saw the clean, full-text 11-entry menu, so the fan-out validates discriminability among the 11 descriptions - NOT routing survival under the listing-truncation pressure issue #43 describes; the post-merge /doctor budget check is the separate, remaining test of that.
description_measured: Patch the Papyrus layer of a mod for Requiem via houseCARL — decide whether content needs a script at all, attach Requiem's existing Nox_*/REQ_* runtime through VirtualMachineAdapter properties, register a modded follower into Requiem's follower system, or compile a new .psc only when truly required. Use when a spell's special mechanic does nothing in game. Load before wiring any script.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies; every judge's reasoning matched its verdict token, so no overrides. Recall (q1-q10): all ten reasoned explicitly to J, consistently distinguishing the runtime/script-wiring layer from E (magic balance) and F (NPC balance) — the E/J and F/J boundaries are the load-bearing ones and both held. Specificity (q11-q20): zero misfires to J. Three near-misses were correctly declined — q15 (cloak-script stack dumps) and q16 (SKSE Papyrus signature lookup) both named J as the only Papyrus-adjacent entry but rejected it as Requiem-integration-scoped rather than script-performance/reference, and q19 (SkyPatcher INI) rejected the whole ESP-override menu on artifact-format grounds. J's description is drawing the right line on both axes.
